gpu_assignment: one GPU per paired seed, both models sequentially on each identical minibatch
intermediate_evaluation: one frozen uniform global validation sample, shared across all models and seeds
final_evaluation: all 46080000 development-validation transitions, streamed once per paired seed
selection: final endpoint only; no validation-based checkpoint or schedule selection
normalization: existing train-only FeatureTransform, fit once on first 1000000 train rows in canonical order
models_and_loss: unchanged 76-input, 8002/8985 trainable-parameter soma voltage models; AdamW weight_decay=1e-5; clip=1; active_weight=4 at abs(delta V)>=5mV
corpus_identity: prepare authenticates existing SEALED.json and its eight files and freezes actual hashes in run.json; no placeholder corpus hashes
precision: existing float32 implementation; no AMP, DDP, compilation or fused-optimizer substitution
interpretation: exposure-scaled transfer of the S3 two-phase schedule; development-validation result, not a fresh independent test or full-state/rollout claim
operational_smoke: tiny paired updates and checkpoint roundtrip on diagnostic rows, discarded; production models and RNG reinitialized from registered seed
